actions.text: Hey {{ user.name }}! Nice to meet you! Welcome to The Zone! I'm Friendly Bot, here to help you get connected to our wonderful community!

return_actions.text: Is there anything else I can help you with? (you can ask me any question!)

trigger.llm_gist: The person wants to stop, cancel, go back, leave the current topic, or says never mind.

Select only when the person's current message clearly says they face immediate physical danger, are considering suicide or self-harm, are being abused, or urgently need a safe responsible adult. Do not select this for greetings, ordinary questions, general distress, ambiguous requests for help, jokes, or figurative language.

actions.text: Hey, thank you for telling me... you do not have to handle this alone. Let me help you find someone to talk to...
Urgent support request from {{ user.name }}. Please contact them as soon as possible. Only information the person provided in this flow may be included.
{{ matched_human.name }} is a trusted person you can contact now: {{ matched_human.telegram_url }}
I can’t reach a trusted person through the bot right now. If you may be in immediate danger, call emergency services or go to a trusted adult near you now.

actions.safe_summary: A safety connection request has no eligible responder.

trigger.llm_gist: The person asks what options are available, what the bot can do, how the bot can help, or asks for a menu.

triggers.llm_gist: The person asks when youth services or gatherings happen but does not name a specific service or group.

actions.text: we have different youth groups for different ages! which are you referring to?

DARE: for secondary school students aged 13-17yo
 Arrow: for post-secondary school students and NSFs aged 17-23yo
 Varsity: for university students

triggers.llm_gist: The person asks for Arrow service timings.

actions.text: Arrow services are held on ARROW_SERVICE_DAY. Doors open at ARROW_DOORS_OPEN_TIME, service starts at ARROW_SERVICE_START_TIME, and ends at ARROW_SERVICE_END_TIME at ARROW_SERVICE_VENUE.

trigger.llm_gist: The person answers the current service-timing question with a service or group other than Arrow.

actions.text: I only have Arrow timing details set up right now. Please add OTHER_SERVICE_NAME, OTHER_SERVICE_DAY, OTHER_SERVICE_START_TIME, and OTHER_SERVICE_VENUE here.

triggers.llm_gist: The person asks for directions to the Star Performing Arts Centre, Star Vista, The Zone or church.

actions.text: Our services are held at Star Vista! Take the MRT to Buona Vista and follow the signs!

1 Vista Exchange Green, Singapore 138617
https://maps.google.com/?q=The+Star+Performing+Arts+Centre

triggers.llm_gist: The person asks what to expect at The Zone, what will happen, what to wear, or whether they may come alone.

actions.text: Come as you are. You can expect music, a message about Jesus, and time to meet other youths. It’s okay to come alone, sit quietly, or ask for someone to meet you before you enter.

triggers.llm_gist: The person asks what The Zone is, what this youth community is, or wants to learn about The Zone.

actions.text: The Zone is a youth community where you can come as you are, meet other youths, and learn about Jesus.

triggers.llm_gist: The person wants to get connected with The Zone or asks for a connection link.

actions.text: Get connected at https://bit.ly//thezonenew! We would love to hear from you!

trigger.llm_gist: The person explicitly asks when Arrow services or gatherings happen.

actions.text: Arrow services are held on ARROW_SERVICE_DAY. Doors open at ARROW_DOORS_OPEN_TIME, service starts at ARROW_SERVICE_START_TIME, and ends at ARROW_SERVICE_END_TIME at ARROW_SERVICE_VENUE.

trigger.llm_gist: The person asks whether there is a youth service today, tomorrow, this week, or asks for the next gathering date.

actions.text: The next gathering is NEXT_GATHERING_DATE at NEXT_GATHERING_TIME. Please add the current event calendar or link: UPCOMING_EVENTS_LINK.

trigger.llm_gist: The person asks how long a youth service, gathering, or event lasts.

actions.text: A typical service lasts SERVICE_DURATION. Please update this if it differs for the service you mean.

trigger.llm_gist: The person asks whether a service or event is cancelled, moved, postponed, or still happening.

actions.text: Please check OFFICIAL_UPDATES_LINK for the latest service updates, or contact OFFICIAL_UPDATES_CONTACT.

trigger.llm_gist: The person asks what NCC is, what NCC stands for, or whether The Zone is part of a church.

actions.text: NCC is New Creation Church. Please add a short approved description here: NCC_DESCRIPTION.

trigger.llm_gist: The person asks who The Zone is for, the age range, whether it is for students, or whether they are allowed to come.

actions.text: The Zone is for YOUTH_AGE_RANGE. Please add the school stages or ages that are welcome: ELIGIBILITY_DETAILS.

trigger.llm_gist: The person asks whether they may come if they are not Christian, unsure about faith, or only want to check The Zone out.

actions.text: You are welcome at The Zone whether or not you are Christian. You can come, ask questions, and take things at your own pace.

trigger.llm_gist: The person asks why they should come, what the point of The Zone is, or what makes it different.

actions.text: The Zone is a place to meet people, explore faith, and grow in community. Please add the approved purpose statement here: THE_ZONE_PURPOSE.

trigger.llm_gist: The person asks whether The Zone, a service, or an event costs money.

actions.text: The Zone costs COST_OR_FREE_DETAILS. Please add any event-specific price, payment, or financial-help details here.

trigger.llm_gist: The person asks what to do on their first visit, where to go when they arrive, or how check-in works.

actions.text: When you arrive, go to FIRST_TIME_WELCOME_POINT and look for FIRST_TIME_TEAM_DESCRIPTION. Please add the check-in details here.

trigger.llm_gist: The person asks whether they need to register, buy a ticket, book a place, or check in before coming.

actions.text: REGISTRATION_REQUIREMENT. Please add the registration link or instructions here: REGISTRATION_LINK.

trigger.llm_gist: The person asks whether they may bring a friend, sibling, parent, or guardian.

actions.text: You are welcome to bring a friend. Please add any guest, sibling, parent, or guardian requirements here: GUEST_POLICY.

trigger.llm_gist: The person asks whether they can still come if they are late, the service has started, or they missed the beginning.

actions.text: You can still come. Please add the late-arrival instructions, entrance, and service-specific limits here: LATE_ARRIVAL_INSTRUCTIONS.

actions.text: Please add the recommended bus services and stop here: BUS_DIRECTIONS.

actions.text: Please add the parking, drop-off, cost, and ride-hailing details here: PARKING_AND_DROPOFF_DETAILS.

trigger.llm_gist: The person asks what language a service is in or whether interpretation is available.

actions.text: Please add the sound, lighting, quiet-space, and sensory-support details here: SENSORY_SUPPORT_DETAILS.

actions.text: You can take things at your own pace. Please add the approved participation and privacy reassurance here: PARTICIPATION_DETAILS.

actions.text: At NCC, we believe Jesus is the Son of God who came to reveal God’s love and give us new life through His death and resurrection.
